newsitem.title: USA: Publishing N.A. unit to lose money in H1.
newsitem.headline: Publishing N.A. unit to lose money in H1.

text.p: Publishing Co of North America Inc said Friday that its new college directory publising unit would reap nearly all of its annual revenue in the second half of the fiscal year, with operating losses incurred on minmal revenues during the first six months of the year.
The recently acquired College Directory Publishing Inc will be the base of the new subsidiary.

"As a result of the acquisition we anticipate our results of operations going forward will now begin to reflect this seaonality, which will make quarter-to-quarter comparisons for the next year difficult at best, and that our new colledge directory publishing subsidiary will contribute favorably to results of operations over the course of an entire year," said chairman Peter Balise.
The company reported second quarter net income of $0.01 per share versus nil per share in the same period a year earlier.
